caption: The drawing features a single, central object, which is a vase with a wide, flared top and a narrow base that extends into a rounded foot. The vase is shaded predominantly in tones of purple and pink, giving it a glass-like appearance with reflective highlights. The highlights are rendered with lighter strokes of white and pale pink to suggest shininess and translucence. The vase sits on a neutral beige background, and a thin rectangular border, also in a faint purple hue, frames the composition. The artist’s signature, "DIMLING," appears in the bottom right corner inside the border. There are no additional objects, decorative elements, or patterns around the vase.
title: Flip Glass
